positions.description:

positions.title: Software Engineer (Domestic Transportation)
positions.description:

• Created api services that interface with a truck scheduling application, done using the SpringBoot framework.
• Worked on migrating our frontend code from Angular to React.
• Exercised test driven development using Spock to maintain a highly tested code base.
